versions.changelog:
Initial release of archive-triage-ocr

- Provides guidelines for archiving and classifying paper receipts vs. app screenshots, emphasizing searchable records.
- Outlines core rules for when to archive, when to ignore, and special cases for long-term retention.
- Describes a standardized OCR workflow, including file processing, engine preference, output format, and maintenance routines.
- Details automated timeline indexing by extracting date, type, and counterparty from filenames and OCR results.
- Recommends directory structure and operational best practices, including regular audit and file integrity checks.
- All instructions are generalized, with sensitive details omitted for privacy.
